definitions:
A unisex given name:
A male given name transferred from the surname.
A female given name transferred from the surname, of modern usage.

blocks.text: Peyton is an English surname and a unisex given name. In Ireland it is known to have been among the anglicized forms of Ó Peatáin.
Peyton Nicole Booker, known professionally as Peyton, is an American singer-songwriter from Houston, Texas.
